title: Ned Finds an Odd Thing
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 (Learning) — longer words with nd, nt, nk, stretch practice.

pages.text: Ned spots a hard thing near the big oak tree.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling peering down at a small, hard, round brown object on the grass under a big oak tree.
Ned the duckling tapping the odd brown object with the tip of his beak.

pages.text: Ned taps it again on the grass.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling tapping the object a second time against the ground.

pages.text: Ned can not tell. He stops to think.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling tilting his head, looking puzzled at the odd brown object.
Ned the duckling carrying the odd brown object over to Pip the sparrow, who is perched on a low branch.

pages.text: Pip looks at the hard thing.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hopping down and peering closely at the odd brown object.

pages.text: It drops off the big oak tree.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pointing up towards the branches of the big oak tree above.

pages.text: It is a hard brown nut.
pages.illustration: A close-up of the hard brown nut, with the big oak tree visible behind it.

pages.text: Ned grins and taps the nut again.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling grinning and tapping the nut once more with his beak.

pages.text: Ned and Pip set off to look for nuts.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling and Pip the sparrow walking together under the big oak tree, looking at the ground for more nuts.
